title: Chapter Review: Transactions and Fault Tolerance

questions.prompt: Which isolation level prevents write skew?
Which implementation of serializability is optimistic and aborts on conflict?
MVCC lets readers and writers proceed without blocking each other.
A booking check looks for overlapping rows that don't exist yet. What's the risk?
Why can't a timeout tell a dead node from a slow one?
options: Both look the same: no response yet

questions.prompt: Retries in four layers turn one failure into 81 attempts. What's the fix?
options: Retry at one layer, within a budget

questions.prompt: Which pattern gives callers an instant error when a dependency is known to be down?
By Little's law, 50 requests a second at 100 ms each means about how many in progress? (number)

options: A slow non-essential service exhausting a page's worker threads

questions.prompt: Why propagate a deadline instead of fixed per-call timeouts?
options: To stop downstream work when the caller has already given up

questions.prompt: Full jitter randomizes each retry's wait over the whole backoff window.
A GC pause lets a lock expire, and the old holder writes anyway. What protects the data?
options: Fencing tokens checked by the storage
